title: Paradox of Choice
coreMove: Use Paradox of Choice as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Paradox of Choice as a specific decision error around choice overload, option set, regret. Traceable support includes Tragic Choices, Auton- omy and Emotional Response to Medical Decisions.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Paradox of Choice as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: use paradox of choice as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.

hook: Do not open with a definition of Paradox of Choice.
Do not use a generic panic-at-a-meeting opener.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable shape where the obvious answer is wrong and the opposite is true.
Do not make Paradox of Choice sound like ordinary carelessness.
examples: No coffee mug, classroom whiteboard, bus depot, radiator, bike helmet, or narrow kitchen shell.
No example may skip the specific mechanics of Paradox of Choice.
